subject: Performance-led trial bridge and conversion pricing proposal
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@polaris-ai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Liam Ortiz <liam.ortiz@polaris-ai.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extend POC window & align ramp milestones

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found the latency profile promising. We're running into a scheduling slip on our internal evals (security review + privacy sign-off), which means the current POC window ends before we can complete the last quality gate.

Can Redwood:
- extend the POC by 4 weeks, and
- add additional pilot credits (we're short on token budget for full regen testing), and
- confirm a conversion price anchor if we hit the MAP milestones (performance and quality gates).

We want to avoid restarting the MAP; instead, we'll align the additional time to the same milestone definitions (latency under 120ms p95 on our workload, and a pass rate >= 92% on the evaluation prompts). If we pass, we'll be ready to commit to a 100k/mo starter commit but need clarity on discount cadence for the first 3 months.

Would appreciate a short note on what you can do and a one-pager MAP amendment we can circulate internally.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of ML Platforms — Polaris AI

+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extend POC window & align ramp milestones

Samira — thanks for the note and context. We can absolutely avoid restarting the MAP; happy to extend the window and propose concrete commercial guardrails.

High level proposal (draft):
- POC extension: +28 days from current end date.
- Pilot credit top-up: additional $7,500 credit (applied to token usage) to cover regen and stress tests.
- Conversion anchor: 100k tokens/month commit with an introductory 20% discount for months 1-3 after conversion (applies to model list price).
- Performance & quality gates: keep your thresholds (<=120ms p95, >=92% eval pass) — if both are met within the extension, we transition to a conversion offer as above.

I'll attach a draft MAP amendment (redwood_map_v1.pdf) and loop Ben for pricing/legal cadence. Can we schedule a 30-min call early next week to run through the plan and finalize gating language for your internal reviewers?

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0122

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@polaris-ai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extend POC window & align ramp milestones

Confirmed — I ran numbers with finance. Details to include in the MAP amendment:

1) Pilot economics
- Top-up: $7,500 credit applied pro-rata to the current billing account (covers ~1.1M tokens on the current model mix).
- One-time free trial extension: 30 days (same entitlement as initial POC).

2) Conversion pricing (if MAP gates are met within extended window)
- Anchor: 100k tokens/month commit.
- Intro discount: 20% off list for first 3 billing cycles after conversion.
- Ramp schedule: month 4+ will bill at standard committed pricing; any increases to throughput will be eligible for stepped discounts (10% for 200-400k, 15% beyond 400k after formal uplift request).
- Performance-led clause: if p95 latency > 160ms for >3 consecutive days, Redwood will provide a one-time credit equal to 10% of that month's committed spend as goodwill while we remediate (ops SLA).

3) Acceptance gates (to be precise in MAP)
- Performance gate: p95 latency <=120ms measured on Polaris eval workload for a continuous 48-hour window.
- Quality gate: >=92% pass rate on your test prompts across 5 representative scenarios.

4) Legal/Contract
- We can deliver a MAP amendment + SOW. Legal wants the amendment to reference the Master Services Agreement (standard) and include a 30-day termination for convenience during the POC extension to avoid prolonged exposure.

I'll draft the numeric terms into the MAP PDF and prepare a SOW spreadsheet for scope. Laura, can you review for legal language? Sergio, can you confirm operational feasibility to reserve the extra capacity for the extension window?

-ben

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
+1 (650) 555-0167

Attachment: sow-polairs-amendment.xlsx (SOW, 45KB stub)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@polaris-ai.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extend POC window & align ramp milestones

Thanks Ben/Tessa — that layout is very helpful. A couple quick asks before we move to signature: 

- Can you tighten the remediation credit language to clarify measurement windows and upper bound? (Polaris legal likes explicit caps.)
- We need an explicit SLA for availability during the extended window (we'd like a 99.5% availability target for the reserved test pool).
- DocuSign for the amendment would speed internal approvals.

If those items are agreeable, we'll route the amendment to procurement and legal and should be able to sign within 5 business days. Can you send the DocuSign link once ready?

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Samira

Samira — we updated the amendment per your asks:
- Remediation credit: capped at 10% of monthly committed spend; measurement window spelled out (daily p95 averaged over 3-day rolling window); exceptions listed for planned maintenance.
- Availability target: we include a 99.5% availability commitment for the reserved test pool during the extension; standard remedies called out in the SLO appendix.

I've looped Legal (Laura) to finalize wording; Laura, Ben and I spoke and agreed to keep the 30-day termination carve for the extension period. Sergio — ops confirmed we can earmark the capacity and apply credits on 2027-04-18 once the amendment is executed.

Next steps: I will generate the DocuSign packet (amendment + SOW) and ping you with the link. Once signed, we'll apply the $7.5k credit and extend the end date by 28 days.

Tessa
